stem: (Select TWO.) Rosewell Analytics wants to confirm exactly how Terraform will resolve a provider that a colleague referred to only by its local name.

choices.text: If no `source` argument is given, Terraform assumes the provider comes from `registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/<LOCAL NAME>`.
A source address always requires an explicit hostname; there is no default registry Terraform assumes.
A full source address is structured as `[<HOSTNAME>/]<NAMESPACE>/<TYPE>`, with the hostname optional.
The local name in a configuration always exactly matches the provider's registry `<TYPE>` segment and cannot be reassigned.
The `<NAMESPACE>` segment of a source address is optional and can always be left out safely.

rationale: Omitting `source` makes Terraform assume the implied default `registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/<LOCAL NAME>`, and a full address is structured `[<HOSTNAME>/]<NAMESPACE>/<TYPE>` with the hostname optional, matching both keys. Claiming there is no default registry contradicts the implied-source rule directly. Claiming a local name can never be reassigned ignores that a compound local name can be used to resolve a naming collision between two providers. Claiming the namespace segment can always be left out is wrong; only the hostname is optional, not the namespace.
